estonia.description: Hétfőre virradóra felfüggesztették a járatok fogadását és indítását két moszkvai repülőtéren, valamint Jaroszlavlban, Kalugában, Nyizsnyij Novgorodban, Krasznodarban, Volgográdban és Szaratovban is.

estonia.title: A rák én vagyok, de több is vagyok nála
estonia.description: Májusban jelent meg Urfi Péter első könyve, a Sansz, amely egyszerre idézi fel a covid időszakának sokszor már elfeledett történéseit és szól arról, hogy mit is jelent mindaz, amikor az embernél váratlanul agydaganatot diagnosztizálnak. A könyv bemutatóján a szerzővel beszélgettünk.

estonia.title: Bocsánatot kért egy német szálloda, mert azt írta egy izraeli érdeklődőnek, hogy zsidókat nem engednek a szállodába
estonia.description: Azzal mentegetőztek, hogy sok hamis foglalást kapnak, és ez okozott frusztrációt, amikor választ írtak, mert azt hitték, egy újabb hamis foglalással van dolguk.

estonia.title: „Tevékenysége nem kívánatos egy alkotmányos demokráciában” – benyújtották a Szuverenitásvédelmi Hivatalt megszüntető törvényjavaslatot
estonia.description: A javaslat szerint a hivatal „egyáltalán nem védte Magyarország szuverenitását, ezzel szemben elsődleges szerepet játszott az autokratikus hatalomgyakorlás támogatásában”.

estonia.title: Konvoj síl NATO prejde cez Slovinsko. Návrat z cvičenia Strong Lineage 26 po výcviku v Lešti zhustí dopravu
estonia.description: Cez Slovinsko prejde v najbližších dňoch konvoj síl NATO z cvičenia Strong Lineage 26. Očakáva sa zhustená premávka medzi Maďarskom a Talianskom.

estonia.title: Štěkání na „velkého psa“ i ponižování prezidenta. Motoristé stanovují novou normu
estonia.description: Útoky na prezidenta Petra Pavla nejsou jen napadáním jeho osoby, je to také stanovení nové normy, jak je možné se o hlavě státu vyjadřovat. Motoristé tím vytváří nový svět, který se v budoucnosti může otočit proti nim, upozornil v novém díle Politické sezóny filozof jazyka Tomáš Koblížek. I zdržování rozhodnutí vlády, kdo pojede na summit NATO, je určitý druh komunikace. Kabinet Andreje Babiše (ANO) dává prezidentovi najevo „ty si musíš počkat“. Ostřelování podle politoložky Anny Shavit baví zejména Motoristy.

estonia.title: Dalekonosnou střelbu rychle nenahradíme, říká expert ke stahování Američanů z Evropy
estonia.description: Problémem stahování amerických vojáků z Evropy není jejich počet, ale především schopnosti, které státy nezvládnou rychle nahradit, řekl ČT analytik Matúš Halás. Jedná se například o přesnou střelbu na vzdálenosti tisíc kilometrů a víc. Americký prezident Donald Trump v květnu oznámil záměr stáhnout pět tisíc vojáků USA z Německa. Z toho plynoucí snížení odstrašujícího potenciálu NATO by mohlo vykompenzovat rozšíření sdílení amerických jaderných zbraní, napsal web Financial Times.

estonia.title: Schizofrenní situace, říká k Pavlově cestě na summit Macinka. Vystrčil jeho účast hájí
estonia.description: Prezident Petr Pavel stále neví, jestli bude součástí delegace na summit NATO v Ankaře. Vláda rozhodnutí o složení delegace odložila na 22. června, původně avizovala už 8. červen. Podle ministra zahraničí Petra Macinky (Motoristé) by Česko mělo být na summitu zastoupeno delegací v čele s premiérem Andreje Babišem (ANO). Ministrovi také vadila prezidentova „kritika vlády“ na návštěvě Estonska. Podle předsedy Senátu Miloše Vystrčila (ODS) by národní zájmy měli hájit „ti nejvyšší, nejsilnější, s největšími kompetencemi“, prezidentovu účast na akci tak podporuje. Diskuzí v Událostech, komentářích provázela Tereza Řezníčková.

estonia.title: Doufejme, že to Trump pochopí, říká Schiller k českým výdajům na obranu
estonia.description: Vláda stále nerozhodla, zda povolí prezidentovi Petru Pavlovi účast na červencovém summitu NATO v Ankaře. „Čeká na informace od ministra obrany,“ vysvětluje to předseda senátního výboru pro záležitosti EU Jan Schiller (ANO). Podle něj je mezi Strakovou akademií a Hradem dohoda, že na summit NATO prezident nepojede, ale pojede na valné shromáždění OSN. Senátor avizuje, že premiér Andrej Babiš (ANO) na jednání Aliance zdůvodní, „proč nejsme schopni dodržet, co jsme slíbili“. „Doufejme, že to pan (prezident USA Donald) Trump pochopí,“ přeje si Schiller a dodává, že Babiš má lepší pozici, protože se s Trumpem zná. V Interview ČT24 moderovaném Danielem Takáčem dále mluvil o budoucnosti českých výdajů na obranu či cestě předsedy Senátu Miloše Vystrčila (ODS) na Tchaj-wan.

estonia.title: Nicușor Dan: Este important ca NATO să îşi întărească prezenţa şi capabilităţile în România după incidentele cu drone
estonia.description: Preşedintele Nicuşor Dan a salutat, miercuri, rezultatele reuniunii Consiliului Nord-Atlantic de la sediul NATO de la Bruxelles, el arătând că aliaţii au exprimat ferm solidaritatea cu Romania după incidentele recente cu drone. Şeful statului consideră că este important ca NATO să îşi întărească prezenţa şi capabilităţile în România, inclusiv în domeniul contracarării dronelor aeriene şi maritime. Preşedintele mai anunţă că a fost agreată accelerarea proiectelor NATO în materie de răspuns la ameninţările prezentate de drone, astfel încât la Summitul de la Ankara să poată fi aprobate măsuri de sprijin pentru Aliaţii vizaţi.

estonia.title: Bulgaria achiziționează prin SAFE şapte sisteme radar GM400 produse de grupul industrial francez Thales
estonia.description: Bulgaria, ţară membră a NATO, a aprobat miercuri achiziţionarea a şapte sisteme radar produse de compania franceză Thales, pentru a-şi moderniza apărarea antiaeriană şi a-şi îndeplini angajamentele faţă de Alianţa Nord-Atlantică, relatează Reuters, care citează media locale.

estonia.title: Daniel Zamfir: Orice alt cabinet, fie el şi tehnocrat, este de preferat Guvernului Bolojan. Când va lua PSD o decizie
estonia.description: Social-democraţii vor lua în perioada următoare o decizie privind susţinerea sau nu a Guvernului Tomac, a declarat, miercuri, liderul senatorilor PSD, Daniel Zamfir, care susţine că „orice alt Guvern instalat, fie el şi tehnocrat, aşa cum este prezentat acum, este de preferat în detrimentul Guvernului Bolojan”.

estonia.title: Răspunsul NATO la cererea României privind întărirea apărării la Marea Neagră după incidentele cu drone
estonia.description: România a adus miercuri în atenția NATO problema dronelor provenite din războiul din Ucraina care au ajuns pe teritoriul național, în cadrul unei reuniuni a Consiliului Nord-Atlantic dedicată securității în regiunea Mării Negre. Ședința, care a durat aproape două ore, a avut loc la solicitarea Bucureștiului, după recentele incidente de la Galați și Constanța.

estonia.title: Războiul a ajuns la Marea Neagră: cum testează Rusia pragul de reacție al NATO pe teritoriul României
estonia.description: Războiul a ajuns la Marea Neagră: cum testează Rusia pragul de reacție al NATO pe teritoriul României

estonia.title: Pericol pe aleea de sub Tâmpa. Zeci de arbori aparent sănătoși riscă să se prăbușească. Ce face primăria
estonia.description: Zeci de copaci din Brașov sunt un pericol real pentru localnici si turiști. Un arbore s-a prăbușit într-un loc vizitat zilnic de sute de oameni, la un an după tragedia de pe aleea de sub Tâmpa, unde un tânăr și-a pierdut viața lovit de un arbore. Specialistii au descoperit ca mulți sunt putreziți în interior, chiar dacă la suprafață pare că sunt sănătoși.

estonia.title: Răspunsul lui Putin la provocarea Lituaniei: Manevre navale ale Rusiei în Marea Baltică, concomitent cu un exerciţiu major al NATO
estonia.description: Marina rusă a desfăşurat exerciţii militare în Marea Baltică, exersând lansări de rachete neghidate, bombardamente şi atacuri cu rachete, a declarat aceasta, în timp ce în regiune aveau loc totodată exerciţii majore ale SUA şi NATO, a relatat marţi agenţia de ştiri Interfax, preluată de Reuters.

estonia.title: FIDELIS revine din 15 iunie cu dobânzi de până la 7,60% în lei și 6,80% în euro. Facilități speciale pentru donatorii de sânge
estonia.description: Ministerul Finanțelor lansează o nouă ediție a programului FIDELIS în perioada 15-22 iunie 2026, cu dobânzi de până la 7,60% pentru titlurile în lei și până la 6,80% pentru cele în euro. Noua ediție vine și cu două tranșe speciale dedicate donatorilor de sânge, în contextul Zilei Internaționale a Donatorului de Sânge, marcată anual pe 14 iunie.

estonia.title: Simion reia tema suspendării lui Nicușor Dan: cere părerea susținătorilor, pe Facebook. De ce este, de fapt, un proces complicat
estonia.description: Liderul AUR a readus în discuție tema suspendării lui Nicușor Dan. De această dată și-a întrebat urmăritorii, printr-o postare pe Facebook, dacă ar trebui să inițieze un astfel de demers. Între lansarea procedurii suspendare și demiterea efectivă a președintelui există însă două praguri esențiale, destul de greu de trecut în acest moment: votul majorității parlamentarilor și validarea rezultatului prin referendum.

estonia.title: Ce paradă pregătește Franța de ziua sa națională, 14 iulie: „Europa nu este singură”. Ucraina va fi omagiată
estonia.description: Parada militară de pe 14 iulie de pe Champs Elysées va fi „mai masivă”, va avea drept temă „trezirea strategică a Europei” şi va încerca să arate că Franţa este „hotărâtă” şi „nu este singură”, a anunţat luni guvernatorul militar al Parisului, relatează AFP.

estonia.title: Consiliului Nord-Atlantic, după incidentele cu drone de la Galați și Constanța: Aliații au reconfirmat solidaritatea deplină cu România. Vor fi luate măsuri aliate suplimentare privind apărarea aeriană și contracararea dronelor pe Flancul Estic
estonia.description: Consiliul Nord-Atlantic a avut miercuri la sediul NATO din Bruxelles, o reuniune dedicată situației de securitate din Marea Neagră, în contextul incidentelor recente cu drone care au afectat România. Reuniunea a oferit prilejul unei evaluări aliate asupra amenințărilor generate de acțiunile Rusiei în regiune, inclusiv asupra celor care afectează direct securitatea României. În cadrul intervenției […] © G4Media.ro .

estonia.title: European Commission marks 85th anniversary of Soviet mass deportations
estonia.description: A memorial ceremony took place at the European Parliament in Brussels on Tuesday to mark the 85th anniversary of the USSR's mass deportations, which sent tens of thousands of Estonians, Latvians and Lithuanians to Siberia and Kazakhstan.

estonia.title: Estonia and Ukraine fail to sign drone deal after Zelenskyy visit
estonia.description: This week, as part of the Ukraine–Nordic–Baltic summit held in Tallinn, Estonia signed a joint declaration with Ukraine on cooperation but did not sign a drone agreement. Latvia, however, did sign a drone agreement.

estonia.title: Architect: Tallinn is not prepared for large‑scale sheltering
estonia.description: Tallinn would face serious problems if tens of thousands of people suddenly had to look for shelter, architect Toivo Tammik warns.

estonia.title: Farmers, berry growers struggle with worsening labor shortages
estonia.description: The agricultural sector is struggling to fill workplaces both for seasonal berry-picking jobs and for more tech-skilled agricultural work.

estonia.title: Riigikogu passes law allowing Estonian prison space to be rented to other countries
estonia.description: The Riigikogu on Wednesday approved amendments to the law allowing prisoners from foreign countries to be housed in Estonian prisons. A vote on ratifying a prison agreement with Sweden will also take place during Wednesday's sitting.

estonia.title: Estonian Parliament approves consent law
estonia.description: On Wednesday, the Riigikogu approved the so‑called consent law, which establishes that clear consent is required for sexual relations.

estonia.title: Most parties oppose means-testing child benefits
estonia.description: Both coalition and opposition politicians have said there are no plans to link the child benefit system in Estonia to income.

estonia.title: Isamaa drags out an important parliamentary session
estonia.description: The Isamaa party is prolonging Wednesday's session of parliament, where several important bills are on the agenda, including prison outsourcing and the consent law.

estonia.title: Social media trend pushes teens toward dangerous 'looksmaxxing'
estonia.description: Emerging social media trends are prompting some teenagers to take extreme risks to enhance their appearance, including striking their own faces with hammers or fists in hopes of achieving more "masculine" features, youth advocates warned.

estonia.title: Estonian municipalities test Starlink to bolster crisis readiness
estonia.description: Estonia's 79 municipalities have been testing Starlink terminals since last month as part of crisis preparedness, Maaleht reported.

estonia.title: Haapsalu Bay's mussel and seaweed farms plan postponed
estonia.description: The Estonian Marine Institute was set to install mussel and seaweed farms in Haapsalu Bay this summer, but failed procurement processes and equipment unsuitable for the bay's shallow waters have delayed the project by a year.

estonia.title: Tallinn mayor: We will use more standardized projects instead of architects
estonia.description: Using architects in the construction of buildings and other facilities in Tallinn creates excessive costs for the city and standardized solutions need to be adopted, Tallinn Mayor Peeter Raudsepp said.

estonia.title: AI Leap project lead: Students say our model is annoying but full of potential
estonia.description: A survey of students found that young people see significant potential in ITI, an artificial intelligence-based learning application developed specifically for Estonia's education system, but also find it "really annoying," AI Leap program head Ivo Visak tells ERR in an interview.

estonia.title: Peeter Kaldre: One blow after another
estonia.description: The current regime in Moscow aims to restore an empire — more precisely, the sphere of influence of the Soviet Union — but Russia appears to be acting almost deliberately foolishly, damaging relations with countries where it seeks to maintain its influence, writes Peeter Kaldre.

estonia.title: Estonian museums to bury underpants to assess soil quality
estonia.description: Estonian agricultural museums will bury cotton underwear at three sites on June 16 to measure soil health, using how quickly the fabric decomposes as an indicator of underground biological activity.

estonia.title: 13 yellow cards shown as Estonia beats Lithuania 1-0 to retain Baltic Cup
estonia.description: Substitute striker Karel Mustmaa scored his first international goal 10 minutes from time as Estonia retained the Baltic Cup with a 1-0 win over Lithuania in Tallinn.

estonia.title: Estonian, 17, crowned European junior finswimming champion
estonia.description: Estonia claimed a gold medal on the opening day of the 2026 CMAS European Championship Finswimming Indoor Juniors, thanks to seventeen-year-old Krete Maalust.

estonia.title: Juhan Kivirähk: The Prime Minister prevents Parliament from doing its job
estonia.description: People expect the Riigikogu to make decisions. If the Reform Party opposes freeing hens from cages, it would be fair to demonstrate that opposition in a parliamentary vote, writes Juhan Kivirähk.

estonia.title: Police, rescue chiefs: Swedish inmates plan creates unequal pay
estonia.description: Officials warn that higher pay for staff hired to guard incoming Swedish inmates in Tartu is risking deeper staff shortages across the country's internal security services.

estonia.title: Major chemical spill in Tallinn's Haabersti district
estonia.description: At 10:15 a.m. on Wednesday, the Emergency Response Center received a report that a large quantity of sodium hypochlorite had leaked from a truck on Õismäe tee in Tallinn's Haabersti district, Delfi reports.

estonia.title: Gallery: Tallinn hosts first ever Paavli Festival
estonia.description: The inaugural Paavli Festival in Tallinn at the weekend attracted close to 1,000 visitors and more than 40 artists.

estonia.title: Baltic, Nordic leaders support opening all 6 EU negotiating clusters for Ukraine
estonia.description: The eight prime ministers of the Baltic and Nordic countries on Tuesday said they backed the opening of European Union accession negotiations for Ukraine this summer.

estonia.title: Ratings: Isamaa doubles its lead over Center Party
estonia.description: Opposition party Isamaa has more than doubled its lead over the Center Party to 6.6 percentage points, according to a recent poll.

estonia.title: History-mad Swedish heavy metal band Sabaton returns to Tallinn stage in 2027
estonia.description: Swedish power metal band Sabaton will be in concert in Tallinn next year, the band has announced.

estonia.title: Widespread power outage hits Tartu and South Estonia
estonia.description: Large parts of Estonia's second-largest city were left without electricity, bringing traffic to a standstill and leaving a major hospital without power.

estonia.title: Ministry of Climate seeking to solve small cities' housing crisis
estonia.description: The Ministry of Climate has completed a housing sector development plan that aims to bring new homes or rental apartments to areas lagging behind in real estate development over the next decade.

estonia.title: Harri Tiido: On the logic of the future
estonia.description: This time, the background discussion series looks at Stephen Heintz's views on the future. Heintz selected 12 concepts rooted in past thinking and proposed alternatives to them — a new approach, writes Harri Tiido.

estonia.title: Latvian PM to ERR: Ukrainian drone experts arriving in Latvia next week
estonia.description: Latvian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs told ERR that Ukrainian experts will be arriving in the Baltic states next week to help deter the threat posed by repeated drone violations.

estonia.title: Moped car gives rural Estonian teen freedom to drive years early
estonia.description: At 15, Türi student Roosi Põllu is already driving herself to school in a moped car, boosting her independence well before Estonia's standard driving age of 18.

estonia.title: Estonia's foreign trade picked up in April
estonia.description: Estonia's exports of goods rose by 13 percent and imports by 12 percent on year to April 2026, Statistics Estonia reported.

estonia.title: Elron to test drone attack response with train passengers on Wednesday
estonia.description: Trains will be stopped on Wednesday afternoon as Estonian Railways (Eesti Raudtee) and Elron practice their response to a drone attack as part of a nationwide exercise.

estonia.title: Tallinn Social Democrats want free city museum admission for kids
estonia.description: Tallinn Social Democrats want to make city museums free for children and teens 18 and under, with the proposal up for city council debate Thursday.

estonia.title: Zelenskyy: A ceasefire affects regional security, not just Ukraine
estonia.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said a potential future ceasefire in Ukraine will affect the whole region, and if the war is stopped quickly, Russia will not have the opportunity to attack another country.

estonia.title: Triathlete Kaidi Kivioja sets Estonian record in full Ironman debut
estonia.description: Estonian endurance athlete Kaidi Kivioja made her full-distance Ironman triathlon debut at the European Championships in Hamburg, setting a new domestic record in the process.

estonia.title: Tallinn to boost school lunch funding from September 1
estonia.description: The City of Tallinn is hiking school lunch funding starting this fall, increasing the daily lunch rate to €2.10 to help maintain meal quality amid rising costs.

estonia.title: At 89, Neeme Järvi reflects on a lifetime in music: 'You embrace the whole world'
estonia.description: Conductor Neeme Järvi, who has just turned 89, said he feels a powerful drive within him that is very hard to slow down. According to Järvi, conducting is the best profession because through music you can embrace the whole world. He was guided toward music by his mother, who was a hairdresser, and his role model was his brother Vallo, who was 14 years older.

estonia.title: Four new clay courts to replace Kadriorg's old tennis infrastructure
estonia.description: Kadriorg Tennis Center has begun reconstructing its old courts and will replace them with four upgraded clay courts, which are expected to be completed later this summer. The center is also in talks with the City of Tallinn about building a new tennis hall.

estonia.title: Gallery: Olena Zelenska, Sirje Karis meet with academic leaders in Tallinn
estonia.description: Ukrainian First Lady Olena Zelenska and Estonian First Lady Sirje Karis met education and research leaders in Tallinn on Tuesday, with a focus on academic cooperation.

estonia.title: Gallery: Architecture students build a new landmark for Tartu from ruins
estonia.description: The traditional construction workshop of first-year architecture and urban planning students from the Estonian Academy of Arts (EKA) began next to the Annelinn Library in Tartu. This year's shelter, titled "Varem" ("Before"), focuses on the life cycle of buildings and reuse, offering the local community a new type of meeting place.

estonia.title: OECD urges Estonia to tighten budget, reform tax system
estonia.description: According to a Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) fresh economic report on Estonia, the country should tighten its budget and reform taxes.

estonia.title: Ukraine's Zelenskyy promises to work with Estonia in countering stray drones
estonia.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy pledged to work with Estonia and other European countries supporting Ukraine to neutralize drones that have crossed into countries neighboring Russia after being diverted from their course due to Russian interference operations.

estonia.title: Man charged with attempted murder over Ülemiste mall blast
estonia.description: Prosecutors have charged a man with attempted murder following an explosion which took place at the Ülemiste keskus mall in Tallinn just before Christmas last year.

estonia.title: Watch: Press conference with NB8 leaders and Volodymyr Zelenskyy
estonia.description: The eight Nordic and Baltic leaders and the Ukrainian Volodymyr Zelenskyy will hold a press conference at the end of Tuesday's NB8 summit. You can watch the press conference on ERR News.

estonia.title: Merle Raun: Mental health policy cannot be separated from economic policy
estonia.description: While economic policy does not directly treat mental health problems, it can create conditions in which people have jobs, homes, prospects for the future and a sense that they have a place in society, Merle Raun writes.

estonia.title: Ukraine to open honorary consuls in Estonia's Narva and Tartu
estonia.description: Ukraine will open two new honorary consuls in Narva and Tartu after signing a bilateral agreement with Estonia on Tuesday.

estonia.title: IMF issues Estonia ballooning public debt warning
estonia.description: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has warned Estonia that if it continues on its current course, the country's public debt is heading down an unsustainable path.

estonia.title: Estonia allows longer truck combinations to boost efficiency
estonia.description: Estonia has begun allowing longer truck combinations on certain routes with special permits, a move aimed at improving freight efficiency and easing driver shortages.

estonia.title: New wildlife atlas shows Estonia's large predators expanding ranges
estonia.description: A new atlas of Estonia's mammals shows large predators expanding their range across the country, even as several smaller species have sharply declined or vanished altogether.

estonia.title: Gallery: Over 60 scarecrows steal the show at rural Estonian museum
estonia.description: More than 60 handmade scarecrows from across Estonia now stand watch over a meadow at Heimtali Museum in Viljandi County, giving old textiles a colorful new lease on life.

estonia.title: Estonia's ministers critical of plan to simplify divorce procedures
estonia.description: Critics of the plan to simplify divorce procedures argue it would come at the expense of the safety of domestic violence victims and children, while Minister of Justice Liisa Pakosta says the goal is precisely to better protect victims of violence.

estonia.title: TOHOH! ⟩ Peavaluga mehel avastati ebatavaline nakkus, mille põhjustas igapäevane hommikusöök
estonia.description: Aastakümneid kestnud hommikusöögiharjumus ei tekitanud 52-aastasele mehele kordagi probleeme. Alles siis, kui migreenid muutusid väljakannatamatuks, avastasid arstid mehe ajust ebatavalise nakkushaiguse.

estonia.title: Richard Gere plaanib rahuliku südamega pensionile jääda: mul on mantlipärija olemas
estonia.description: Gere’i (76) ja tema ekskaasa Carey Lowelli (65) 26-aastane poeg tegi tänavu oma teledebüüdi HBO hittsarja «Euphoria» kolmandas hooajas, kus ta kehastab tõusvat filmitähte Dylan Reidi. Lisaks saab teda koos modell Kaia Gerberiga näha Ryan Murphy uues sarjas «The Shards», mis esilinastub juba augustis.

estonia.title: UURING KINNITAB ⟩ Tarbijad hindavad head disaini, kuid sellega käib kaasas ka varjukülg
estonia.description: Võltsitud disaintoodete levik mõjutab märgatavalt Euroopa majandust, sealhulgas Eestit, kus kahju ulatub moe ja aksessuaaridega seotud sektorites kümnetesse miljonitesse eurodesse.

estonia.title: PILK PEALE ⟩ Luksuslik minimaja otse jõe kaldal! Pamela Maran pani müüki hinnalise kinnistu
estonia.description: «Ainulaadne jõeäärne kinnistu Selja jõe kaldal – koht, kuhu saab ehitada oma unistuste kodu,» seisab kinnisvaraportaali kv.ee riputatud kuulutuses, millega on müüki pandud kinnistu Lääne-Virumaal Haljala vallas.

latvia.title: EU eyes developing new joint military capabilities to curb reliance on US
latvia.description: The new push comes amid fresh worries about the U.S. commitment to NATO.

latvia.title: A magyarok többsége szerint Trump ártott Európa és az USA kapcsolatának
latvia.description: Negyedük szerint a károk az elnök hivatali ideje után is megmaradnak. Az EU-ban egyre kevésbé látják szövetségesnek Amerikát, és fontosnak tartják a saját védelem erősítését.

latvia.title: Lentulai Krisztián bocsánatot kért Magyar Péter anyjától
latvia.description: Amiért megosztotta Kocsis Máté becsületsértő posztját.

latvia.title: Ukrán dróncsapás ért egy személyvonatot a Krímben
latvia.description: Hétfőre virradóra felfüggesztették a járatok fogadását és indítását két moszkvai repülőtéren, valamint Jaroszlavlban, Kalugában, Nyizsnyij Novgorodban, Krasznodarban, Volgográdban és Szaratovban is.

latvia.title: Felmondott Papp Dániel, az MTVA vezérigazgatója
latvia.description: Az MTVA-t 2018 óta vezető Papp arra hivatkozott, hogy „az újonnan megválasztott kormány szándéka a közmédia teljes átalakítása.”

latvia.title: A rák én vagyok, de több is vagyok nála
latvia.description: Májusban jelent meg Urfi Péter első könyve, a Sansz, amely egyszerre idézi fel a covid időszakának sokszor már elfeledett történéseit és szól arról, hogy mit is jelent mindaz, amikor az embernél váratlanul agydaganatot diagnosztizálnak. A könyv bemutatóján a szerzővel beszélgettünk.

latvia.title: Kinevezték a MÁV Szolgáltató Központ Zrt. új vezérigazgatóját
latvia.description: A cég teljes megújulást ígér.

latvia.title: Bocsánatot kért egy német szálloda, mert azt írta egy izraeli érdeklődőnek, hogy zsidókat nem engednek a szállodába
latvia.description: Azzal mentegetőztek, hogy sok hamis foglalást kapnak, és ez okozott frusztrációt, amikor választ írtak, mert azt hitték, egy újabb hamis foglalással van dolguk.

latvia.title: Leváltották a Nemzeti Infokommunikációs Szolgáltató vezérigazgatóját is
latvia.description: Vetési Iván helyére Simon Lajost nevezte ki Tanács Zoltán tudományos és technológiai miniszter.

latvia.title: „Tevékenysége nem kívánatos egy alkotmányos demokráciában” – benyújtották a Szuverenitásvédelmi Hivatalt megszüntető törvényjavaslatot
latvia.description: A javaslat szerint a hivatal „egyáltalán nem védte Magyarország szuverenitását, ezzel szemben elsődleges szerepet játszott az autokratikus hatalomgyakorlás támogatásában”.

latvia.title: Teljesen megtelt a balti gázkapu, évtizedekre lekötötték a litván LNG-terminál kapacitásait
latvia.description: Rendkívül erős regionális kereslet mellett szinte a teljes szabad kapacitását értékesítette a litvániai klaipedai LNG-terminál- írta meg a Montel. Darius Silenskis, a működtető KN Energies vezérigazgatója bejelentette, hogy a balti gázpiac kulcsfontosságú kapujának számító infrastruktúra kapacitásait 2032-ig 100 százalékban, míg 2044-ig mintegy 75 százalékban kötötték le a piaci szereplők, köztük olyan energiacégek, mint az azeri gázt is vásárló norvég Equinor vagy az ukrán Naftogaz.

latvia.title: Konvoj síl NATO prejde cez Slovinsko. Návrat z cvičenia Strong Lineage 26 po výcviku v Lešti zhustí dopravu
latvia.description: Cez Slovinsko prejde v najbližších dňoch konvoj síl NATO z cvičenia Strong Lineage 26. Očakáva sa zhustená premávka medzi Maďarskom a Talianskom.

latvia.title: Štěkání na „velkého psa“ i ponižování prezidenta. Motoristé stanovují novou normu
latvia.description: Útoky na prezidenta Petra Pavla nejsou jen napadáním jeho osoby, je to také stanovení nové normy, jak je možné se o hlavě státu vyjadřovat. Motoristé tím vytváří nový svět, který se v budoucnosti může otočit proti nim, upozornil v novém díle Politické sezóny filozof jazyka Tomáš Koblížek. I zdržování rozhodnutí vlády, kdo pojede na summit NATO, je určitý druh komunikace. Kabinet Andreje Babiše (ANO) dává prezidentovi najevo „ty si musíš počkat“. Ostřelování podle politoložky Anny Shavit baví zejména Motoristy.

latvia.title: Dalekonosnou střelbu rychle nenahradíme, říká expert ke stahování Američanů z Evropy
latvia.description: Problémem stahování amerických vojáků z Evropy není jejich počet, ale především schopnosti, které státy nezvládnou rychle nahradit, řekl ČT analytik Matúš Halás. Jedná se například o přesnou střelbu na vzdálenosti tisíc kilometrů a víc. Americký prezident Donald Trump v květnu oznámil záměr stáhnout pět tisíc vojáků USA z Německa. Z toho plynoucí snížení odstrašujícího potenciálu NATO by mohlo vykompenzovat rozšíření sdílení amerických jaderných zbraní, napsal web Financial Times.

latvia.title: Resort obrany připravuje přezbrojení střední brigády
latvia.description: Resort obrany připravuje další velkou zakázku. Půjde o přezbrojení střední brigády, která by měla dostat nová kolová bojová vozidla pěchoty. Potvrdil to ministr obrany Jaromír Zůna (za SPD). Armáda chce nahradit stávající obrněnce Pandur, které už podle ní nevyhovují aktuálním potřebám. Soutěž na nové má být otevřená.

latvia.title: Schizofrenní situace, říká k Pavlově cestě na summit Macinka. Vystrčil jeho účast hájí
latvia.description: Prezident Petr Pavel stále neví, jestli bude součástí delegace na summit NATO v Ankaře. Vláda rozhodnutí o složení delegace odložila na 22. června, původně avizovala už 8. červen. Podle ministra zahraničí Petra Macinky (Motoristé) by Česko mělo být na summitu zastoupeno delegací v čele s premiérem Andreje Babišem (ANO). Ministrovi také vadila prezidentova „kritika vlády“ na návštěvě Estonska. Podle předsedy Senátu Miloše Vystrčila (ODS) by národní zájmy měli hájit „ti nejvyšší, nejsilnější, s největšími kompetencemi“, prezidentovu účast na akci tak podporuje. Diskuzí v Událostech, komentářích provázela Tereza Řezníčková.

latvia.title: Doufejme, že to Trump pochopí, říká Schiller k českým výdajům na obranu
latvia.description: Vláda stále nerozhodla, zda povolí prezidentovi Petru Pavlovi účast na červencovém summitu NATO v Ankaře. „Čeká na informace od ministra obrany,“ vysvětluje to předseda senátního výboru pro záležitosti EU Jan Schiller (ANO). Podle něj je mezi Strakovou akademií a Hradem dohoda, že na summit NATO prezident nepojede, ale pojede na valné shromáždění OSN. Senátor avizuje, že premiér Andrej Babiš (ANO) na jednání Aliance zdůvodní, „proč nejsme schopni dodržet, co jsme slíbili“. „Doufejme, že to pan (prezident USA Donald) Trump pochopí,“ přeje si Schiller a dodává, že Babiš má lepší pozici, protože se s Trumpem zná. V Interview ČT24 moderovaném Danielem Takáčem dále mluvil o budoucnosti českých výdajů na obranu či cestě předsedy Senátu Miloše Vystrčila (ODS) na Tchaj-wan.

latvia.title: Nicușor Dan: Este important ca NATO să îşi întărească prezenţa şi capabilităţile în România după incidentele cu drone
latvia.description: Preşedintele Nicuşor Dan a salutat, miercuri, rezultatele reuniunii Consiliului Nord-Atlantic de la sediul NATO de la Bruxelles, el arătând că aliaţii au exprimat ferm solidaritatea cu Romania după incidentele recente cu drone. Şeful statului consideră că este important ca NATO să îşi întărească prezenţa şi capabilităţile în România, inclusiv în domeniul contracarării dronelor aeriene şi maritime. Preşedintele mai anunţă că a fost agreată accelerarea proiectelor NATO în materie de răspuns la ameninţările prezentate de drone, astfel încât la Summitul de la Ankara să poată fi aprobate măsuri de sprijin pentru Aliaţii vizaţi.

latvia.title: Bulgaria achiziționează prin SAFE şapte sisteme radar GM400 produse de grupul industrial francez Thales
latvia.description: Bulgaria, ţară membră a NATO, a aprobat miercuri achiziţionarea a şapte sisteme radar produse de compania franceză Thales, pentru a-şi moderniza apărarea antiaeriană şi a-şi îndeplini angajamentele faţă de Alianţa Nord-Atlantică, relatează Reuters, care citează media locale.

latvia.title: Daniel Zamfir: Orice alt cabinet, fie el şi tehnocrat, este de preferat Guvernului Bolojan. Când va lua PSD o decizie
latvia.description: Social-democraţii vor lua în perioada următoare o decizie privind susţinerea sau nu a Guvernului Tomac, a declarat, miercuri, liderul senatorilor PSD, Daniel Zamfir, care susţine că „orice alt Guvern instalat, fie el şi tehnocrat, aşa cum este prezentat acum, este de preferat în detrimentul Guvernului Bolojan”.

latvia.title: Răspunsul NATO la cererea României privind întărirea apărării la Marea Neagră după incidentele cu drone
latvia.description: România a adus miercuri în atenția NATO problema dronelor provenite din războiul din Ucraina care au ajuns pe teritoriul național, în cadrul unei reuniuni a Consiliului Nord-Atlantic dedicată securității în regiunea Mării Negre. Ședința, care a durat aproape două ore, a avut loc la solicitarea Bucureștiului, după recentele incidente de la Galați și Constanța.

latvia.title: Războiul a ajuns la Marea Neagră: cum testează Rusia pragul de reacție al NATO pe teritoriul României
latvia.description: Războiul a ajuns la Marea Neagră: cum testează Rusia pragul de reacție al NATO pe teritoriul României

latvia.title: Pericol pe aleea de sub Tâmpa. Zeci de arbori aparent sănătoși riscă să se prăbușească. Ce face primăria
latvia.description: Zeci de copaci din Brașov sunt un pericol real pentru localnici si turiști. Un arbore s-a prăbușit într-un loc vizitat zilnic de sute de oameni, la un an după tragedia de pe aleea de sub Tâmpa, unde un tânăr și-a pierdut viața lovit de un arbore. Specialistii au descoperit ca mulți sunt putreziți în interior, chiar dacă la suprafață pare că sunt sănătoși.

latvia.title: Răspunsul lui Putin la provocarea Lituaniei: Manevre navale ale Rusiei în Marea Baltică, concomitent cu un exerciţiu major al NATO
latvia.description: Marina rusă a desfăşurat exerciţii militare în Marea Baltică, exersând lansări de rachete neghidate, bombardamente şi atacuri cu rachete, a declarat aceasta, în timp ce în regiune aveau loc totodată exerciţii majore ale SUA şi NATO, a relatat marţi agenţia de ştiri Interfax, preluată de Reuters.

latvia.title: FIDELIS revine din 15 iunie cu dobânzi de până la 7,60% în lei și 6,80% în euro. Facilități speciale pentru donatorii de sânge
latvia.description: Ministerul Finanțelor lansează o nouă ediție a programului FIDELIS în perioada 15-22 iunie 2026, cu dobânzi de până la 7,60% pentru titlurile în lei și până la 6,80% pentru cele în euro. Noua ediție vine și cu două tranșe speciale dedicate donatorilor de sânge, în contextul Zilei Internaționale a Donatorului de Sânge, marcată anual pe 14 iunie.

latvia.title: Simion reia tema suspendării lui Nicușor Dan: cere părerea susținătorilor, pe Facebook. De ce este, de fapt, un proces complicat
latvia.description: Liderul AUR a readus în discuție tema suspendării lui Nicușor Dan. De această dată și-a întrebat urmăritorii, printr-o postare pe Facebook, dacă ar trebui să inițieze un astfel de demers. Între lansarea procedurii suspendare și demiterea efectivă a președintelui există însă două praguri esențiale, destul de greu de trecut în acest moment: votul majorității parlamentarilor și validarea rezultatului prin referendum.

latvia.title: Ce paradă pregătește Franța de ziua sa națională, 14 iulie: „Europa nu este singură”. Ucraina va fi omagiată
latvia.description: Parada militară de pe 14 iulie de pe Champs Elysées va fi „mai masivă”, va avea drept temă „trezirea strategică a Europei” şi va încerca să arate că Franţa este „hotărâtă” şi „nu este singură”, a anunţat luni guvernatorul militar al Parisului, relatează AFP.

latvia.title: Consiliului Nord-Atlantic, după incidentele cu drone de la Galați și Constanța: Aliații au reconfirmat solidaritatea deplină cu România. Vor fi luate măsuri aliate suplimentare privind apărarea aeriană și contracararea dronelor pe Flancul Estic
latvia.description: Consiliul Nord-Atlantic a avut miercuri la sediul NATO din Bruxelles, o reuniune dedicată situației de securitate din Marea Neagră, în contextul incidentelor recente cu drone care au afectat România. Reuniunea a oferit prilejul unei evaluări aliate asupra amenințărilor generate de acțiunile Rusiei în regiune, inclusiv asupra celor care afectează direct securitatea României. În cadrul intervenției […] © G4Media.ro .

latvia.title: European Commission marks 85th anniversary of Soviet mass deportations
latvia.description: A memorial ceremony took place at the European Parliament in Brussels on Tuesday to mark the 85th anniversary of the USSR's mass deportations, which sent tens of thousands of Estonians, Latvians and Lithuanians to Siberia and Kazakhstan.

latvia.title: Estonia and Ukraine fail to sign drone deal after Zelenskyy visit
latvia.description: This week, as part of the Ukraine–Nordic–Baltic summit held in Tallinn, Estonia signed a joint declaration with Ukraine on cooperation but did not sign a drone agreement. Latvia, however, did sign a drone agreement.

latvia.title: Latvian PM to ERR: Ukrainian drone experts arriving in Latvia next week
latvia.description: Latvian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs told ERR that Ukrainian experts will be arriving in the Baltic states next week to help deter the threat posed by repeated drone violations.

latvia.title: Richard Gere plaanib rahuliku südamega pensionile jääda: mul on mantlipärija olemas
latvia.description: Gere’i (76) ja tema ekskaasa Carey Lowelli (65) 26-aastane poeg tegi tänavu oma teledebüüdi HBO hittsarja «Euphoria» kolmandas hooajas, kus ta kehastab tõusvat filmitähte Dylan Reidi. Lisaks saab teda koos modell Kaia Gerberiga näha Ryan Murphy uues sarjas «The Shards», mis esilinastub juba augustis.

latvia.title: KUKU ⟩ Vseviov: me oleme Euroopas rohkem ühel meelel kui meediast välja paistab
latvia.description: Välisministeeriumi kantsler Jonatan Vseviov tegi Kuku saates «Sihik» kokkuvõtte Ukraina presidendi visiidist ja rääkis, et just täna on Euroopas laual otsused, mis määravad tuleviku.

latvia.title: Jaanika Elias esitleb debüütromaani «Vähemalt ei ela Susanna Põlvas»
latvia.description: 17. juunil kell 18 toimub Apollo Plaza raamatupoes Jaanika Eliase raamatu «Vähemalt ei ela Susanna Põlvas» esitlus. Autoriga vestleb kirjastus Tänapäeva toimetaja Mari Karlson.

latvia.title: Using NATO jets to down drones not a long-term solution, say Latvian President and PM
latvia.description: The use of NATO fighter jets to protect Latvian airspace and shoot down foreign drones, which happened for the first time in Latvia on Monday, is not a long-term solution. Instead, the country should focus on developing and strengthening its air defence capabilities. This was stated by President Edgars Rinkēvičs and Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (Joint List) at their weekly press conference after a bilateral meeting on Wednesday, June 10th (video below).

latvia.title: Actor Richard Gere talks Tibetan Buddhism on Latvian Television
latvia.description: The popular Hollywood actor Richard Gere appeared on Latvian television's Viens pret Vienu (One on One) in-depth interview show this week, talking mainly about the role of Buddhism in his life.

latvia.title: Orange alert for rain and hail in Latvia on Thursday
latvia.description: Heavy rain is expected in Latvia on Thursday, according to the Latvian Environment, Geology and Meteorology Centre.

latvia.title: Flights diverted from Rīga to Tallinn over drone suspicions Tuesday
latvia.description: Two planes en route to Rīga were diverted to Tallinn Airport on Tuesday evening. Passengers shared this information on the social media platform Facebook, where the discussion has since been deleted. A representative from “Latvian Air Traffic” explained that the flights were diverted due to a drone that was reportedly spotted, but unconfirmed, Latvian Radio reports on June 10.

latvia.title: Latvian and Polish ammo makers to cooperate
latvia.description: Latvian ammunition manufacturer Ammunity said on June 10th it has started to cooperate with one of Poland’s most important defence companies.

latvia.title: Interview: Bacterial resistance risks deaths from simple infections
latvia.description: The world is facing a silent pandemic that many don’t even notice – antimicrobial resistance. Bacteria are becoming resistant to antibiotics and threatening the lives of many people, says professor Dimitri Van der Linden, a paediatric infectious disease specialist from Belgium, in an interview with Latvian Radio's Laura Dzērve.

latvia.title: Bloomsday book giveaway at Latvian National Library
latvia.description: Fans of literature in general and Irish literature in particular will be delighted to learn that on June 16th they can obtain a free example of Irish writing, available in both English and Latvian.

latvia.title: Subscriptions open for first IPO of a state-owned company in Latvia
latvia.description: The subscription for the shares of LAU Infra Group AS within the framework of the initial public offering (IPO) begins today, June 10th. The company will publicly offer up to 6,400,421 shares, which are planned to be listed on the Nasdaq Riga Baltic Main List after the IPO.

latvia.title: Organic farming has deep roots in Valmiera district
latvia.description: There is a growing interest in organic farming in rural Latvia, and one of the reasons is to be less dependent on external resources, as the price of mineral fertilizers is increasing, and plant protection products will also become more expensive, reports Latvian Radio from northern Vidzeme region.

latvia.title: LISTEN: La Bohème, live from the Latvian National Opera
latvia.description: June 4th saw the premiere of a new production of Giacomo Puccini's crowd-pleasing classic La Bohème at the Latvian National Opera in Rīga.

latvia.title: Competition Council: Bolt is not abusing its position in taxi market
latvia.description: The Competition Council (KP) concluded in its investigation on June 10 that "Bolt Operations OÜ" (Bolt) holds a dominant position in the market for commercial passenger transportation by car and taxi services. At the same time, the KP acknowledged that there is no proof that Bolt has abused its dominant position.

latvia.title: New 'mobility hubs' set up in Rīga
latvia.description: In May, four new "mobility hubs" were put into operation in Rīga – at the "Mangaļi," "Gaisma," and "Vecdaugava" railway stops, and on Slokas Street near the Iļģuciems freight station, according to the Rīga City Council.

latvia.title: Latvia mulls compensation in case of drone damage
latvia.description: Following several drone incidents along Latvia’s border, a question has arisen: what would happen if an unmanned aerial vehicle damaged equipment, a building, or other property? While the government plans to introduce a compensation mechanism, it remains unclear how farmers would be protected in such cases, Latgale Regional Television reported on June 10.

latvia.title: Latgale tourism to be given financial state support
latvia.description: To strengthen Latgale’s tourism industry, which has been negatively impacted in terms of revenue by frequent airspace alerts, the Ministry of Economics plans to reallocate 1.5 million euros to various tourism activities, according to Minister of Economics Viktors Valainis (Greens and Farmers Union) on the Latvian Radio programme "Good Morning" on June 10.

latvia.title: Passenger assaults and robs train conductor in Latvia
latvia.description: A man physically assaulted a female train ticket conductor around midnight on Saturday, June 6, and stole a bag containing money and work equipment, the State Police confirmed.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 9th June, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Latvian football team wrecked on the shores of the Faroe Islands
latvia.description: Latvia finished rank last in this year's Baltic Cup football tournament on June 9th following a second defeat.

latvia.title: Plan to introduce e-cigarette deposit system still hanging in the air
latvia.description: Discussions on the potential introduction of an e-cigarette deposit system will continue in the Saeima, reports Latvian Radio.

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Latvia versus Faroe Islands Baltic Cup international football
latvia.description: Latvia sadly did not make the final of this year's Baltic Cup football tournament, but nevertheless, LTV is providing live coverage of the tournament's conclusion.

latvia.title: Double-digit export rise for Latvia in April
latvia.description: Central Statistical Bureau (CSB) provisional data published on June 9th show that in April 2026 Latvia had foreign trade turnover of EUR 4.13 billion, which at current prices was 12.6 % higher than a year ago.

latvia.title: Latvian government will pay pharmacist fees in future
latvia.description: Meanwhile, Ukrainian civilians covered by the Ukrainian Civilian Support Law will no longer be exempt from paying a pharmacist's service fee for a prescription.

latvia.title: Annual inflation at 3.5% in May in Latvia
latvia.description: The data of the Central Statistical Bureau (CSB) show that in May 2026, compared to April 2026, the average level of consumer prices increased by 0.5 %.

latvia.title: Estonia wants to fly cows from Rīga Airport
latvia.description: Estonia plans to use Riga Airport as its main transhipment and dispatch point for the export of live cattle to Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan, according to information provided by the Ministry of Agriculture (ZM) at Tuesday's government meeting, LSM.lv reports.

latvia.title: Coalition wants to keep reduced diesel tax until end of 2026
latvia.description: The coalition parties have agreed to maintain the reduced excise tax rates on diesel fuel until the end of this year, Finance Minister Māris Kučinskis told the LETA news agency on Monday following a meeting of the coalition parties.

latvia.title: Latvia and Ukraine sign defence cooperation agreement
latvia.description: On June 9th, the Latvian Cabinet of Ministers supported the Ministry of Defence's report "On the Agreement with Ukraine on Cooperation in the Field of Defense", which provides for comprehensive cooperation between the two countries over the next 10 years, with the possibility of a subsequent extension.

latvia.title: Valga Hot Shorts film fest returns in July
latvia.description: The enjoyable Valga Hot Shorts film festival is making a welcome return to the Estonian side of the Valka-Valga twin cities' border, and there's always plenty of Latvian interest in the showcase event, too.

latvia.title: Prototype Baltic bunker system being tested in Latvia
latvia.description: A prototype of the 'Baltic defence line' which is planned to be constructed along the borders of the Baltic states with Russia and Belarus is currently being constructed and tested at the Sēlija military training range in southern Latvia, reports Latvian Television.

latvia.title: ERR: Latvian Rail Baltica delays could cost Estonia
latvia.description: Latvia's inability to complete Rail Baltic construction by the set deadline will inevitably end up costing Estonia as well, Estonian Auditor General Janar Holm said, according to a report from Estonian public media ERR News.

latvia.title: Railway crossings to be upgraded, 'Latvian Railways' promises
latvia.description: "Latvian Railways" plans to improve safety conditions at and near 45 railroad crossings over the next two years. The company made this announcement on Monday following reports of a man being struck by a train in Imanta, Latvian Television reported on June 8.

latvia.title: Mūkusala promenade in Rīga to be fixed soon
latvia.description: After several months, repair work on the Mūkusalas Promenade in Riga is nearing completion. Although the promenade was opened to the public last December, the contractor had to address deficiencies identified immediately after opening. The work is scheduled to be completed this month, Latvian Television reported on June 9.

latvia.title: New book of stories published in easy Latvian language
latvia.description: The "Valters un Rapa" publishing house and book shop has published a third book in its series "Stories in Easy Language", continuing its work in promoting the accessibility of original Latvian literature to everyone.

latvia.title: Why do Latvian universities spend thousands to attract foreign students?
latvia.description: Latvian higher education institutions spend thousands to attract foreign students to their courses. How and why this happens, Latvian Radio explained for the benefit of anyone unable to work it out for themselves.

latvia.title: Baltic and Nordic Prime Ministers meet Zelenskyy in Tallinn
latvia.description: The Prime Ministers of the Baltic and Nordic states are in Tallinn, Estonia on Tuesday for a meeting with Ukraine's outstanding President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, reports Latvian Television.

latvia.title: Drone search will likely not continue in Latvia
latvia.description: On Monday, the wreckage of the drone that was shot down in Latvian airspace was not found, as it most likely "broke into many small pieces," Māris Tūtins, head of the Information Analysis and Management Department of the Joint Staff of the National Armed Forces (NBS), told the Latvian Television programme Morning Panorama on June 9.

latvia.title: Latvian nature researcher Guntis Eniņš passes away aged 92
latvia.description: Latvia has lost a legendary naturalist and guardian of trees – Guntis Eniņš, who would have celebrated his 93rd birthday on June 18.

latvia.title: Latvian interceptor drones being tested for use on eastern border
latvia.description: During the international military exercises "Baltic Zenith 2026" currently taking place at the Jūrmalciems military aviation training ground, Latvian-made interceptor drones are being tested. The Ministry of Defence says that such systems are planned to be deployed to defend the eastern border, Kurzeme Television reported on June 8.

latvia.title: Latvian volunteer soldier in Ukraine dies
latvia.description: Latvian volunteer soldier Uldis Volmārs has passed away. He was one of the first to go to the front lines in February 2022 to help the Ukrainians, Latvian Television reports.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 8th June, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Rēzekne's former mayor incriminated in expensive spa case
latvia.description: The Corruption Prevention and Combating Bureau (KNAB) is calling for criminal proceedings to be initiated against the former mayor of Rēzekne, Aleksandrs Bartaševičs (Together for Latvia), who may have abused his official position regarding the construction of a spa centre, KNAB stated on June 8.

latvia.title: Drone downing shows NATO willingness to defend Latvia, says senior soldier
latvia.description: The first ever downing of a foreign drone in Latvian airspace on Monday, June 8th confirms the NATO alliance's determination to protect every centimetre of the country, Brigadier General Ilmārs Atis Lejiņš, Deputy Commander of NATO's Multinational Division "North", said on the Latvian Radio programme 'Krustpunktā' ('At the Crossroads').

latvia.title: Latvia targets illicit cigarette factories via equipment suppliers
latvia.description: In order to improve customs risk management and increase the efficiency of control, the Customs Administration department of Latvia's tax service, VID with the support of experts from the European Commission (EC), has launched a new initiative which aims to identify cigarette production equipment, components and the raw materials necessary for illicit cigarette production, using the Safety and Security Analytics (SSA) system developed by the EC and the capabilities of artificial intelligence (AI).

latvia.title: Latvia had nearly 20 thousand vacancies in first quarter
latvia.description: Central Statistical Bureau data published on June 8 show that in Q1 2026, the Latvian labour market had 19.8 thousand job vacancies, of which 10.8 thousand jobs were vacant in the private sector and 8.9 thousand in the public sector.

latvia.title: Stamp honours Latvian para-athletes
latvia.description: On June 12, Latvijas Pasts will issue a stamp dedicated to the first medal, a bronze, won by Latvian athletes at the Winter Paralympic Games.

latvia.title: WATCH: Estonian and Latvian Prime Ministers' press conference
latvia.description: Latvian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs makes his first foreign visit since assuming power on Monday, May 8th, with a short trip north to Estonia.

latvia.title: Mosquitoes will arrive around Midsummer, says bug expert
latvia.description: The feeling that there have been fewer mosquitoes so far this year is indeed justified, entomologist Voldemārs Spuņģis confirmed in an interview with LSM.lv on June 8.

latvia.title: Rothko Museum opens Summer season in Daugavpils
latvia.description: On Friday, 5th June, the Rothko Museum in Daugavpils opened its summer exhibition season, bringing together photography, painting and ceramics from Latvia, Lithuania, China and South Africa.

latvia.title: Second air hazard alert in eastern Latvia is now over
latvia.description: A second air threat alert in eastern Latvia on Monday is now over.

latvia.title: Rīga meeting helps advance single Baltic capital market concept
latvia.description: On Saturday, June 6th, during the annual meeting of the Board of Governors of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) in Rīga, the Finance Ministers of Latvia, Estonia and Lithuania, together with EBRD President Odile Renaud-Basso, signed a memorandum of understanding on further cooperation in the development of a single Baltic capital market.

latvia.title: Foreign Affairs Committees of Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania and Türkiye meet in Tallinn
latvia.description: On June 8th and 9th, the delegations of the Foreign Affairs Committees of the parliaments of Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania will meet with their counterparts from the Parliament of Türkiye in Tallinn, Estonia, to discuss the security situation and further support to Ukraine.

latvia.title: Mixed picture on Latvian labour productivity
latvia.description: In the first quarter of 2026, labour productivity in the EU increased slightly by 0.1% based on both persons and hours worked, compared with the same quarter of the previous year, according to fresh Eurostat statistics.

latvia.title: Par to rauc degunu, to izmet, taču nav labāka dabiskā kolagēna avota locītavām kā šis
latvia.description: Ungāru gastronomijā ir daudzi ēdieni, kas vietējiem šķiet pavisam ierasti, taču ārvalstu viesiem bieži vien tie šķiet neparasti vai pat pārsteidzoši. latvia.description: Igaunijas galvaspilsētā Tallinā notiekošā Baltijas valstu un Ziemeļvalstu (NB8) samita laikā Latvijas Ministru prezidents Andris Kulbergs (AS) un Ukrainas prezidents Volodimirs Zelenskis parakstīja abu valstu vienošanos par visaptverošu sadarbību aizsardzības jomā, nodrošinot Ukrainas pieredzes pārņemšanu gaisa telpas aizsardzībai pret dronu uzbrukumiem, aģentūrai LETA pavēstīja Kulberga komunikācijas padomniece Elīna Šverna. Vienošanās ietvaros Ukraina apņēmusies sniegt atbalstu […]

latvia.title: Ukraiņi gandrīz masveidā spiesti pamest Poliju – iemesls tam ir gaužām nepatīkams; kas tagad ieņems ukraiņu vietu?
latvia.description: Ukraiņi arvien biežāk un biežāk izvēlas pamest Poliju, bet viņu darbavietas aizņem migranti no Āzijas un Latīņamerikas. Kā raksta Polijas portāls WNP, šī tendence kļūst arvien izteiktāka, radot bažas par iespējamo ietekmi uz Polijas ekonomiku, kurā ukraiņu darbaspēkam pēdējos gados bijusi būtiska loma. Polijas darba tirgus pašlaik piedzīvo straujas pārmaiņas. Ukraiņi, kuri gadiem ilgi bija […]

latvia.title: Tiesībsardze Saeimas atbildīgo komisiju iepazīstina ar situāciju bāriņtiesu jomā
latvia.description: Šodien, 9. jūnijā, notika Saeimas Cilvēktiesību un sabiedrisko lietu komisijas sēde, kurā deputāti uzklausīja tiesībsardzes Karinas Palkovas ziņojumu par nepieciešamību pārskatīt pašreizējo bāriņtiesu institucionālo modeli, iepazīstinot ar esošo situāciju, Tiesībsarga birojā saņemtajām sūdzībām, konstatētajiem trūkumiem, kā arī priekšlikumiem, kas būtu darāms, lai sistēmu sakārtotu. latvia.title: “Dizaina degradācija Saulkrastu centrālajā pludmalē.” Vietējie skarbi vērtē tieši skaistāko risinājumu – kāpēc?
latvia.description: Sociālajos tīklos diezgan plašu rezonansi vietējā kopienā un arī plašākā publikā guvis publicētais ieraksts ar attēliem par Saulkrastu centrālās pludmales labiekārtojumu un tā izmaiņām. Tur tiek salīdzināti 2014. gada dizaina soli un dēļu celiņa izskats ar pašreizējo situāciju pēc nesen veiktajiem remontdarbiem. latvia.title: Horoskopi 10. jūnijam. Apkārtējie šodien var nebūt gatavi pieņemt vai novērtēt to, ko vēlies piedāvāt
latvia.description: Auns Tev jābūt gatavam saskarties ar grūtībām, īpaši tad, ja vēlies sasniegt sev svarīgu mērķi. Ceļā uz rezultātu var nākties atteikties no ieradumiem, kas tevi kavē, piemēram, no slinkuma, vilcināšanās vai vēlmes atlikt darāmo uz vēlāku laiku. Mērķa sasniegšana bieži prasa pacietību, disciplīnu un gatavību rīkoties arī tad, kad tas nav viegli vai ērti. Svarīgi […]

lithuania.title: EU eyes developing new joint military capabilities to curb reliance on US
lithuania.description: The new push comes amid fresh worries about the U.S. commitment to NATO.

lithuania.title: A magyarok többsége szerint Trump ártott Európa és az USA kapcsolatának
lithuania.description: Negyedük szerint a károk az elnök hivatali ideje után is megmaradnak. Az EU-ban egyre kevésbé látják szövetségesnek Amerikát, és fontosnak tartják a saját védelem erősítését.

lithuania.title: Lentulai Krisztián bocsánatot kért Magyar Péter anyjától
lithuania.description: Amiért megosztotta Kocsis Máté becsületsértő posztját.

lithuania.title: Ukrán dróncsapás ért egy személyvonatot a Krímben
lithuania.description: Hétfőre virradóra felfüggesztették a járatok fogadását és indítását két moszkvai repülőtéren, valamint Jaroszlavlban, Kalugában, Nyizsnyij Novgorodban, Krasznodarban, Volgográdban és Szaratovban is.

lithuania.title: A rák én vagyok, de több is vagyok nála
lithuania.description: Májusban jelent meg Urfi Péter első könyve, a Sansz, amely egyszerre idézi fel a covid időszakának sokszor már elfeledett történéseit és szól arról, hogy mit is jelent mindaz, amikor az embernél váratlanul agydaganatot diagnosztizálnak. A könyv bemutatóján a szerzővel beszélgettünk.

lithuania.title: Bocsánatot kért egy német szálloda, mert azt írta egy izraeli érdeklődőnek, hogy zsidókat nem engednek a szállodába
lithuania.description: Azzal mentegetőztek, hogy sok hamis foglalást kapnak, és ez okozott frusztrációt, amikor választ írtak, mert azt hitték, egy újabb hamis foglalással van dolguk.

lithuania.title: „Tevékenysége nem kívánatos egy alkotmányos demokráciában” – benyújtották a Szuverenitásvédelmi Hivatalt megszüntető törvényjavaslatot
lithuania.description: A javaslat szerint a hivatal „egyáltalán nem védte Magyarország szuverenitását, ezzel szemben elsődleges szerepet játszott az autokratikus hatalomgyakorlás támogatásában”.

lithuania.title: Konvoj síl NATO prejde cez Slovinsko. Návrat z cvičenia Strong Lineage 26 po výcviku v Lešti zhustí dopravu
lithuania.description: Cez Slovinsko prejde v najbližších dňoch konvoj síl NATO z cvičenia Strong Lineage 26. Očakáva sa zhustená premávka medzi Maďarskom a Talianskom.

lithuania.title: Štěkání na „velkého psa“ i ponižování prezidenta. Motoristé stanovují novou normu
lithuania.description: Útoky na prezidenta Petra Pavla nejsou jen napadáním jeho osoby, je to také stanovení nové normy, jak je možné se o hlavě státu vyjadřovat. Motoristé tím vytváří nový svět, který se v budoucnosti může otočit proti nim, upozornil v novém díle Politické sezóny filozof jazyka Tomáš Koblížek. I zdržování rozhodnutí vlády, kdo pojede na summit NATO, je určitý druh komunikace. Kabinet Andreje Babiše (ANO) dává prezidentovi najevo „ty si musíš počkat“. Ostřelování podle politoložky Anny Shavit baví zejména Motoristy.

lithuania.title: Dalekonosnou střelbu rychle nenahradíme, říká expert ke stahování Američanů z Evropy
lithuania.description: Problémem stahování amerických vojáků z Evropy není jejich počet, ale především schopnosti, které státy nezvládnou rychle nahradit, řekl ČT analytik Matúš Halás. Jedná se například o přesnou střelbu na vzdálenosti tisíc kilometrů a víc. Americký prezident Donald Trump v květnu oznámil záměr stáhnout pět tisíc vojáků USA z Německa. Z toho plynoucí snížení odstrašujícího potenciálu NATO by mohlo vykompenzovat rozšíření sdílení amerických jaderných zbraní, napsal web Financial Times.

lithuania.title: Schizofrenní situace, říká k Pavlově cestě na summit Macinka. Vystrčil jeho účast hájí
lithuania.description: Prezident Petr Pavel stále neví, jestli bude součástí delegace na summit NATO v Ankaře. Vláda rozhodnutí o složení delegace odložila na 22. června, původně avizovala už 8. červen. Podle ministra zahraničí Petra Macinky (Motoristé) by Česko mělo být na summitu zastoupeno delegací v čele s premiérem Andreje Babišem (ANO). Ministrovi také vadila prezidentova „kritika vlády“ na návštěvě Estonska. Podle předsedy Senátu Miloše Vystrčila (ODS) by národní zájmy měli hájit „ti nejvyšší, nejsilnější, s největšími kompetencemi“, prezidentovu účast na akci tak podporuje. Diskuzí v Událostech, komentářích provázela Tereza Řezníčková.

lithuania.title: Doufejme, že to Trump pochopí, říká Schiller k českým výdajům na obranu
lithuania.description: Vláda stále nerozhodla, zda povolí prezidentovi Petru Pavlovi účast na červencovém summitu NATO v Ankaře. „Čeká na informace od ministra obrany,“ vysvětluje to předseda senátního výboru pro záležitosti EU Jan Schiller (ANO). Podle něj je mezi Strakovou akademií a Hradem dohoda, že na summit NATO prezident nepojede, ale pojede na valné shromáždění OSN. Senátor avizuje, že premiér Andrej Babiš (ANO) na jednání Aliance zdůvodní, „proč nejsme schopni dodržet, co jsme slíbili“. „Doufejme, že to pan (prezident USA Donald) Trump pochopí,“ přeje si Schiller a dodává, že Babiš má lepší pozici, protože se s Trumpem zná. V Interview ČT24 moderovaném Danielem Takáčem dále mluvil o budoucnosti českých výdajů na obranu či cestě předsedy Senátu Miloše Vystrčila (ODS) na Tchaj-wan.

lithuania.title: Nicușor Dan: Este important ca NATO să îşi întărească prezenţa şi capabilităţile în România după incidentele cu drone
lithuania.description: Preşedintele Nicuşor Dan a salutat, miercuri, rezultatele reuniunii Consiliului Nord-Atlantic de la sediul NATO de la Bruxelles, el arătând că aliaţii au exprimat ferm solidaritatea cu Romania după incidentele recente cu drone. Şeful statului consideră că este important ca NATO să îşi întărească prezenţa şi capabilităţile în România, inclusiv în domeniul contracarării dronelor aeriene şi maritime. Preşedintele mai anunţă că a fost agreată accelerarea proiectelor NATO în materie de răspuns la ameninţările prezentate de drone, astfel încât la Summitul de la Ankara să poată fi aprobate măsuri de sprijin pentru Aliaţii vizaţi.

lithuania.title: Bulgaria achiziționează prin SAFE şapte sisteme radar GM400 produse de grupul industrial francez Thales
lithuania.description: Bulgaria, ţară membră a NATO, a aprobat miercuri achiziţionarea a şapte sisteme radar produse de compania franceză Thales, pentru a-şi moderniza apărarea antiaeriană şi a-şi îndeplini angajamentele faţă de Alianţa Nord-Atlantică, relatează Reuters, care citează media locale.

lithuania.title: Daniel Zamfir: Orice alt cabinet, fie el şi tehnocrat, este de preferat Guvernului Bolojan. Când va lua PSD o decizie
lithuania.description: Social-democraţii vor lua în perioada următoare o decizie privind susţinerea sau nu a Guvernului Tomac, a declarat, miercuri, liderul senatorilor PSD, Daniel Zamfir, care susţine că „orice alt Guvern instalat, fie el şi tehnocrat, aşa cum este prezentat acum, este de preferat în detrimentul Guvernului Bolojan”.

lithuania.title: Răspunsul NATO la cererea României privind întărirea apărării la Marea Neagră după incidentele cu drone
lithuania.description: România a adus miercuri în atenția NATO problema dronelor provenite din războiul din Ucraina care au ajuns pe teritoriul național, în cadrul unei reuniuni a Consiliului Nord-Atlantic dedicată securității în regiunea Mării Negre. Ședința, care a durat aproape două ore, a avut loc la solicitarea Bucureștiului, după recentele incidente de la Galați și Constanța.

lithuania.title: Războiul a ajuns la Marea Neagră: cum testează Rusia pragul de reacție al NATO pe teritoriul României
lithuania.description: Războiul a ajuns la Marea Neagră: cum testează Rusia pragul de reacție al NATO pe teritoriul României

lithuania.title: Pericol pe aleea de sub Tâmpa. Zeci de arbori aparent sănătoși riscă să se prăbușească. Ce face primăria
lithuania.description: Zeci de copaci din Brașov sunt un pericol real pentru localnici si turiști. Un arbore s-a prăbușit într-un loc vizitat zilnic de sute de oameni, la un an după tragedia de pe aleea de sub Tâmpa, unde un tânăr și-a pierdut viața lovit de un arbore. Specialistii au descoperit ca mulți sunt putreziți în interior, chiar dacă la suprafață pare că sunt sănătoși.

lithuania.title: Răspunsul lui Putin la provocarea Lituaniei: Manevre navale ale Rusiei în Marea Baltică, concomitent cu un exerciţiu major al NATO
lithuania.description: Marina rusă a desfăşurat exerciţii militare în Marea Baltică, exersând lansări de rachete neghidate, bombardamente şi atacuri cu rachete, a declarat aceasta, în timp ce în regiune aveau loc totodată exerciţii majore ale SUA şi NATO, a relatat marţi agenţia de ştiri Interfax, preluată de Reuters.

lithuania.title: FIDELIS revine din 15 iunie cu dobânzi de până la 7,60% în lei și 6,80% în euro. Facilități speciale pentru donatorii de sânge
lithuania.description: Ministerul Finanțelor lansează o nouă ediție a programului FIDELIS în perioada 15-22 iunie 2026, cu dobânzi de până la 7,60% pentru titlurile în lei și până la 6,80% pentru cele în euro. Noua ediție vine și cu două tranșe speciale dedicate donatorilor de sânge, în contextul Zilei Internaționale a Donatorului de Sânge, marcată anual pe 14 iunie.

lithuania.title: Simion reia tema suspendării lui Nicușor Dan: cere părerea susținătorilor, pe Facebook. De ce este, de fapt, un proces complicat
lithuania.description: Liderul AUR a readus în discuție tema suspendării lui Nicușor Dan. De această dată și-a întrebat urmăritorii, printr-o postare pe Facebook, dacă ar trebui să inițieze un astfel de demers. Între lansarea procedurii suspendare și demiterea efectivă a președintelui există însă două praguri esențiale, destul de greu de trecut în acest moment: votul majorității parlamentarilor și validarea rezultatului prin referendum.

lithuania.title: Ce paradă pregătește Franța de ziua sa națională, 14 iulie: „Europa nu este singură”. Ucraina va fi omagiată
lithuania.description: Parada militară de pe 14 iulie de pe Champs Elysées va fi „mai masivă”, va avea drept temă „trezirea strategică a Europei” şi va încerca să arate că Franţa este „hotărâtă” şi „nu este singură”, a anunţat luni guvernatorul militar al Parisului, relatează AFP.

lithuania.title: Consiliului Nord-Atlantic, după incidentele cu drone de la Galați și Constanța: Aliații au reconfirmat solidaritatea deplină cu România. Vor fi luate măsuri aliate suplimentare privind apărarea aeriană și contracararea dronelor pe Flancul Estic
lithuania.description: Consiliul Nord-Atlantic a avut miercuri la sediul NATO din Bruxelles, o reuniune dedicată situației de securitate din Marea Neagră, în contextul incidentelor recente cu drone care au afectat România. Reuniunea a oferit prilejul unei evaluări aliate asupra amenințărilor generate de acțiunile Rusiei în regiune, inclusiv asupra celor care afectează direct securitatea României. În cadrul intervenției […] © G4Media.ro .

lithuania.title: European Commission marks 85th anniversary of Soviet mass deportations
lithuania.description: A memorial ceremony took place at the European Parliament in Brussels on Tuesday to mark the 85th anniversary of the USSR's mass deportations, which sent tens of thousands of Estonians, Latvians and Lithuanians to Siberia and Kazakhstan.

lithuania.title: 13 yellow cards shown as Estonia beats Lithuania 1-0 to retain Baltic Cup
lithuania.description: Substitute striker Karel Mustmaa scored his first international goal 10 minutes from time as Estonia retained the Baltic Cup with a 1-0 win over Lithuania in Tallinn.

lithuania.title: KUKU ⟩ Vseviov: me oleme Euroopas rohkem ühel meelel kui meediast välja paistab
lithuania.description: Välisministeeriumi kantsler Jonatan Vseviov tegi Kuku saates «Sihik» kokkuvõtte Ukraina presidendi visiidist ja rääkis, et just täna on Euroopas laual otsused, mis määravad tuleviku.

lithuania.title: Using NATO jets to down drones not a long-term solution, say Latvian President and PM
lithuania.description: The use of NATO fighter jets to protect Latvian airspace and shoot down foreign drones, which happened for the first time in Latvia on Monday, is not a long-term solution. Instead, the country should focus on developing and strengthening its air defence capabilities. This was stated by President Edgars Rinkēvičs and Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (Joint List) at their weekly press conference after a bilateral meeting on Wednesday, June 10th (video below).

lithuania.title: Drone downing shows NATO willingness to defend Latvia, says senior soldier
lithuania.description: The first ever downing of a foreign drone in Latvian airspace on Monday, June 8th confirms the NATO alliance's determination to protect every centimetre of the country, Brigadier General Ilmārs Atis Lejiņš, Deputy Commander of NATO's Multinational Division "North", said on the Latvian Radio programme 'Krustpunktā' ('At the Crossroads').

lithuania.title: Rothko Museum opens Summer season in Daugavpils
lithuania.description: On Friday, 5th June, the Rothko Museum in Daugavpils opened its summer exhibition season, bringing together photography, painting and ceramics from Latvia, Lithuania, China and South Africa.

lithuania.title: Rīga meeting helps advance single Baltic capital market concept
lithuania.description: On Saturday, June 6th, during the annual meeting of the Board of Governors of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) in Rīga, the Finance Ministers of Latvia, Estonia and Lithuania, together with EBRD President Odile Renaud-Basso, signed a memorandum of understanding on further cooperation in the development of a single Baltic capital market.

lithuania.title: Foreign Affairs Committees of Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania and Türkiye meet in Tallinn
lithuania.description: On June 8th and 9th, the delegations of the Foreign Affairs Committees of the parliaments of Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania will meet with their counterparts from the Parliament of Türkiye in Tallinn, Estonia, to discuss the security situation and further support to Ukraine.

lithuania.description: Jautājumu par to, vai Krievija ir spējīga mainīties, TV24 raidījumā “Aktuālais par karadarbību Ukrainā” analizēja Jānis Slaidiņš, NBS majors, Zemessardzes štāba virsnieks. lithuania.title: Zelenskis izsakās par problemātisko situāciju, kādā Putins novedis Krieviju – kara gaita pakāpeniski mainās
lithuania.description: Plašā intervijā laikrakstam “The Guardian” Ukrainas prezidents Volodimirs Zelenskis pauda pārliecību, ka kara gaita pakāpeniski sāk nosvērties Ukrainas labā. lithuania.title: “Mēs nevaram palikt vienaldzīgi”: “Civinity” ziedo transportlīdzekļus Ukrainas atbalstam
lithuania.description: AS “Civinity Mājas” sadarbībā ar “Civinity Group” īstenojusi kopīgu iniciatīvu Ukrainas atbalstam, ziedojot trīs transportlīdzekļus, kas tiks izmantoti humānās palīdzības nodrošināšanā. lithuania.description: Jau vakar vēstījām, ka Ministru prezidents Andris Kulbergs (AS) uzskata, ka nākotnē regulāri notriekt Latvijas un Baltijas valstu gaisa telpā ielidojošus dronus ar iznīcinātājiem nebūtu racionāli. lithuania.title: “Karš ir ļoti tuvu,” raksta ārzemju medijs, informējot par vakar Latvijā notriekto dronu

Jau zināms, ka 8. jūnijā franču iznīcinātājs notriecis dronu, kas no Krievijas ielidojis NATO sabiedrotās Latvijas gaisa telpā. lithuania.title: Po smurto nakties Belfaste įtariamas užpuolikas atvesdintas į teismą
lithuania.description: Prieš Belfasto teismą trečiadienį stojo sudanietis, įtariamas žiauriu užpuolimu panaudojant peilį, išprovokavusiu siaubingu vadinamą smurtą prieš imigrantus Šiaurės Airijoje.

lithuania.title: Ministras Liuksemburge apsilankė ukrainiečių įkurtoje dronų gamykloje, pakvietė testuotis Lietuvoje
lithuania.description: Krašto apsaugos ministras Robertas Kaunas apsilankė Liuksemburge gyvenančių ukrainiečių įkurtoje dronų gamykloje, kur susipažino su gaminamų dronų techniniais parametrais, dirbtinio intelekto taikymu bei pakvietė ukrainiečių gamintojus atvykti testuotis į Lietuvą.

lithuania.title: Nustatė, kad amžinoji cheminė medžiaga TFA yra toksiška
lithuania.description: Europos cheminių medžiagų agentūra (ECHA) trečiadienį pareiškė rekomenduojanti vadinamąją amžinąją cheminę medžiagą TFA priskirti prie žmonių reprodukcijai kenkiančių toksiškų medžiagų.

lithuania.title: Kada ir kaip, pasakyti negali: pinigų banko sąskaitoje įmonė pasigedo ne iš karto
lithuania.description: Teisėsaugininkai aiškinasi, kaip iš vienos Žemaitijos įmonės banko sąskaitos dingo tūkstantinė suma pinigų.

lithuania.title: Derybos dėl koalicijos prasidėjo: paaiškėjo, ko nori demokratai ir koks jų „slaptas planas“
lithuania.description: Trečiadienio pavakare valdantieji socialdemokratai ir „valstiečiai“ sėdo prie derybų stalo su demokratais dėl naujos koalicijos. Demokratai padarė savo namų darbus – paruošė per 70 pasiūlymų koalicijos sutarčiai. Jie taip pat ateina ir su aiškiais pageidavimais dėl pozicijų valdžioje, tačiau dar turi ir kelis galbūt netikėtai „išlįsiančius“ variantus, įtraukiančius ir laikinąjį partijos pirmininką Virginijų Sinkevičių.
